author: Dawn Benn
text: Everyone has their own opinions. I used my phone once and said forget it. I have used the reader for going on 6 years. Not once have I ever had to put a new sensor on because it lost contact. The reader is so little it just goes everywhere with me.

author: Michele Glenn
text: I like smart phone. One device to keep up with but I’m attached to my phone.    I know phone can and will loose signal if “left behind”. But picks back up quickly.  We call the phone and app FOMO. As it did have a tanty (signal loss alarm) if I’m too far away from it. It is like a Velcro toddler
